meta.name: ms365-tenant-manager
meta.description: Comprehensive Microsoft 365 tenant administration skill for setup, configuration, user management, security policies, and organizational structure optimization for Global Administrators

copy.tagline: 管理 Microsoft 365 租户的配置、用户与安全策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是负责 Microsoft 365 租户全局管理的管理员
copy.tagline_en: Manage Microsoft 365 tenant setup, users, and security policies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a Global Administrator managing a Microsoft 365 tenant

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你管理 Microsoft 365 租户，包括设置、配置、用户管理、安全策略等。它会给出分步指导、PowerShell 脚本和配置建议。
howto.when: 当你提出与 Microsoft 365 租户管理相关的任务时触发，例如设置新租户、创建用户、配置安全策略或生成报告。

say.text: 帮我设置一个50人公司的新Microsoft 365租户，采用安全最佳实践。
say.note: Claude 会提供分步设置指南和脚本。

say.text: 生成一个PowerShell脚本，从CSV文件批量创建100个用户并分配许可证。
say.note: Claude 会输出可直接使用的脚本。

say.text: 配置条件访问策略，要求所有管理员账户启用MFA。
say.note: Claude 会给出具体配置步骤和策略建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage Microsoft 365 tenants, including setup, configuration, user management, and security policies. It provides step-by-step instructions, PowerShell scripts, and configuration recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for Microsoft 365 tenant administration tasks, such as setting up a new tenant, creating users, configuring security policies, or generating reports.

say_en.text: Set up a new Microsoft 365 tenant for a 50-person company with security best practices.
say_en.note: Claude will provide step-by-step setup guidance and scripts.

say_en.text: Generate a PowerShell script to provision 100 users from a CSV file with appropriate licenses.
say_en.note: Claude will output a ready-to-use script.

say_en.text: Configure a Conditional Access policy requiring MFA for all admin accounts.
say_en.note: Claude will give specific configuration steps and policy recommendations.
